subject: ai
question: Explain the complete process of a fuzzy system with a block diagram.
title: Fuzzy: In, Think, Out
hook: What if a computer could say 'a bit warm'?
answer: Block diagram: crisp input -> fuzzifier -> inference engine (reads the rule base) -> defuzzifier -> crisp output
Fuzzification: turns the crisp input into degrees of membership (example: 30 degrees is warm 0.67 and hot 0.33)
Rule base: IF-THEN rules (IF warm THEN fan medium; IF hot THEN fan fast)
Inference: each rule fires only as strongly as its input is true (outputs clipped at 0.67 and 0.33) and the results are merged into one fuzzy shape
Defuzzification: converts the combined shape to one crisp value, e.g. the centroid (balance point, about 61, so the fan runs at 61%)
